title: Impacto 2.0: Mobile Smoking Cessation Across Texas
official: Impacto 2.0: Addressing Disparities in Smoking Cessation Access and Outcomes for Hispanic Adults Who Smoke in Texas
summary: This is a preliminary efficacy trial that will examine whether Impacto 2.0 produces higher rates of biochemically verified smoking abstinence among Hispanic adults across Texas compared to the NCI quitSTART app. The primary objective is to evaluate the preliminary efficacy of Impacto 2.0 in reducing smoking, tobacco withdrawal, and craving. One hundred Hispanic adults who smoke will be recruited across Texas and followed remotely over an 8-week intervention period with a 3-month post-quit follow-up.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Self-identifies as Hispanic/Latino/a
* Currently resides in Texas
* Age 18 years or older
* Currently smokes combustible cigarettes daily, biochemically verified by expired carbon monoxide \>7 ppm using the CoVita iCOquit Smokerlyzer
* Meets criteria for elevated anxiety sensitivity (cut-off score of 5 on the Short Scale Anxiety Sensitivity Index)
* Motivated to quit smoking
* Able to provide informed consent
* Has daily access to an iPhone or Android smartphone
* Fluent in English or Spanish

Exclusion Criteria:

* Current use of vaping/e-cigarettes, cigars, cigarillos, pipes, cannabis products, or other nicotine/tobacco products in addition to combustible cigarettes
* Current participation in alcohol or drug-use treatment, including smoking-cessation treatment
* Current psychotherapy for anxiety or depression
* Concurrent use of medication for anxiety or depression
* Active suicidality (ideation, intent, and/or plan)
* Current psychosis
* Currently pregnant, nursing, or actively trying to conceive, including male participants who report that they or a partner are actively trying to conceive
* Myocardial infarction within the past 2 weeks
* Uncontrolled high blood pressure
* Participants with the ability to become pregnant must provide a negative urine pregnancy test before final eligibility/onboarding
